facts.title: hazard report during start-up after maintenance on G-8101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on G-8101, G-8103 and TT-8101 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. G-8101 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 31 August 2011 a hazard report was recorded on G-8101, G-8103 and TT-8101 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during start-up after maintenance; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
